gate1_output_equals_impress.criterion: generated tokens (T1-T3) and per-layer used sets (T2-T3) equal the IMPRESS arm executed in the same session, every request

gate2_prefetch_off_equals_impress.criterion: prefetch off: generated tokens, read bytes (total, probe, K, V) and read call counts equal the IMPRESS arm executed in the same session, every request

gate3_unread_rows_not_used.criterion: every visual row of the prefix cache holds NaN before the first layer; rows are overwritten only by reads; at masked columns the debug wrapper passes 0 (what an unread row holds in a normal request), nowhere else: the attention output of every layer is finite, the unmasked visual columns equal the layer's used set, every used row was read, and tokens and used sets equal IMPRESS

gate4_repeat.criterion: the same request executed a second time: generated tokens equal, every request (the prefetched amount may differ)

gate5_no_read_started_after_stop.criterion: reads started after the stop = 0 in every layer (and so at most one read, the one in flight, ends after the stop)
gate5_no_read_started_after_stop.note: latest_read_call_relative_to_stop_ms: the largest (time the read call was issued - stop time) over all prefetch reads; a read is allowed under the lock before the stop and issued right after the lock is released, so the value may exceed 0 by that delay
